name: 2026 Example Long Course Age Group Championships
location: Example Aquatic Center, 123 Main St, City, ST 00000
_sessions_comment: sessions: ordered list of all sessions in chronological order.
session_type must be exactly one of: 'Prelims', 'Finals', 'Timed Finals', 'Time Trials'
day must be the full day name: 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'
date must be ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD' — this is what the app itself writes to the file.
start_time and warmup_time: 12-hour format with AM/PM, e.g. '9:00 AM'
field order on a session object: id, name, session_type, date, day, start_time, warmup_time, pool_sessions, notes, locked
pool_sessions: one entry per SIMULTANEOUS PHYSICAL pool in this session.
DEFAULT IS ONE POOL. Only split into multiple pool_sessions if the facility description
explicitly supports simultaneous multi-pool competition (rare for Long Course/LCM venues;
more common for Short Course/SCY facilities that can be split into two courses).
When a genuine split is confirmed, alternate which gender is Pool 1 across successive
field order on a pool_session object: id, pool_number, name, age_groups, events, num_lanes, course, notes
pool_session.course: 'SCY' (short course yards), 'SCM' (short course meters), or 'LCM' (long course meters).
Determine from the meet's title/classification and qualifying-time-standards table — do not
default to SCY. A 'Long Course' meet with meter-based qualifying times swims LCM throughout.
pool_session.age_groups: list of age group strings, e.g. ['11-12', '13-14'] or ['10 & Under'].
_events_comment: Each event dict in pool_session.events MUST have (in this key order):
'number', 'description', 'gender', 'age_group', 'course', 'is_relay',
'relay_type' (only if is_relay), 'deck_seeded', 'fastest_heat_finals'
'description' format: '{age_group} {Girls|Boys|Mixed} {distance}{course} {stroke}'
e.g. '13-14 Girls 100M Breaststroke'. For Mixed exhibition events omit Girls/Boys.
'gender': 'F' for Girls/Women, 'M' for Boys/Men, 'Mixed' for combined-gender exhibition events.
'deck_seeded': true ONLY for events explicitly in the sanction's positive check-in table —
never inferred purely from event distance.
'fastest_heat_finals': true when only the fastest checked-in heat(s) of an event advance to a
Finals session while remaining heats swim elsewhere (prelims / end of an earlier session).
EVENTS SPLIT ACROSS HEATS: if the sanction's Order of Events lists the same event number more
than once with different heat groupings (e.g. 'Heats 1-3' then 'Heats 4+', or '17/1','17/2',
'17/3','17/4+' interspersed among other events), create one event dict PER OCCURRENCE, all
sharing the same 'number', placed in their literal Order-of-Events position, with the heat
label appended to 'description' in parentheses, e.g. '11-12 Girls 400M IM (Heats 1-3)'.
EVENTS NUMBERED IN ONE BLOCK BUT SWUM IN ANOTHER: some events are assigned a number within one
session's Order of Events table but the sanction narrative states they're actually contested
in a different session (e.g. an age group's 200 back/fly/breast numbered in an afternoon Timed
Finals block but actually swum interspersed with that evening's Finals). Place the event ONLY
in the session where it is actually swum.
BREAKS: scheduled breaks in the Order of Events must appear as their own event-list entries:
{'number': 0, 'description': '10-minute break', 'gender': '', 'is_relay': false,
'relay_type': null, 'is_break': true, 'break_minutes': 10} — positioned exactly where the
break occurs. This exact shape is required for the app to display it correctly.
EXHIBITION / PARA / MIXED EVENTS: include non-scored Mixed-gender exhibition events (e.g. Para
events) as real event entries at their correct position, using gender: 'Mixed'.
For Finals sessions: repeat the same event numbers as the corresponding Prelims.
For a genuinely split multi-pool Timed Finals session: each pool_session only contains its own
gender's events.
Girls events have odd numbers, Boys events have even numbers (typical USA Swimming convention).
Relays should include relay_type. Medley Relays and Freestyle Relays are the two types.

sessions.name: Thursday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session (one competition pool — most facilities, especially Long Course venues, only have one). Positive check-in required. 11-12 400M IM: fastest (up to) 3 heats swim slow to fast alternating girls/boys (heats 1-3, shown as their own event entries); additional heats (4+) swim fast to slow alternating girls/boys later in the same session (also its own event entries, same event number).

sessions.name: Friday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 Preliminaries. 10-minute scheduled break shown as its own event entry between events 14 and 15/16 (see 'Breaks' in the prompt). 400M Freestyle Relay: fastest heat of girls & boys relay teams swims in Friday Finals — remaining heats swim here at the end of prelims.

sessions.name: Friday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 Finals interspersed with 11-12 200M Backstroke, an event numbered in the afternoon Timed Finals block but actually swum here per the sanction narrative — up to 3 fastest checked-in heats swim here (shown as separate 'Heat 1'/'Heat 2'/'Heat 3' entries, only heats 1 and 4+ shown in this trimmed example), heats 4+ at the end. A non-scored, no-fee 13-14 Para Mixed 100M Event is contested during this session. 10-minute break before the relay. Fastest heat of the 400M Freestyle Relay swims here.

_fixed_fields_comment: The following fields are always present with these exact values, in this order, for a new meet.
